content: The governed primary checkout is /work/Vermory in filesystem namespace workstation-alpha.
The client starts from /work/Vermory/internal/runtime and the trusted probe resolves /work/Vermory before MCP startup.
A second coding client receives the same trusted attachment and reconnects to the governed continuity.
Unrelated same-name paths, unadopted worktrees, mirrors, clones, unknown namespaces, and conflicting anchors must abstain rather than attach by similarity.
The operator explicitly adopts the resolver worktree and later rebinds the primary checkout to /srv/Vermory; both actions remain auditable and reversible.
The remote MCP server uses only its startup attachment and never asks the model to choose a tenant, path binding, alias, adopt, or rebind action.
